name: Resources - Tool and kit management
description: Verifies resource and kit management: tool inventory, kit assembly, assignment to orders, and availability tracking

planSteps.description: Assert that resources page shows tool/equipment inventory with availability status
Navigate to /dashboard/resources/kits and view the list of typical kits per activity type
Create a new kit: name it, add tools from inventory, set quantities
Assert that the kit is created and tools are marked as 'reserved' or 'in-kit'
Assign the kit to an existing order and verify the order's resource requirements update
Check tool availability by navigating to /dashboard/tools and verifying the list with status badges
